This '''unidentified male''' was the [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cagaran Wei]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].<ref name="conviction" />

During former [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Vestara Khai]]'s investigation of Wei's disappearance, Luke had the [[Theran Listener]] [[Taselda]] speak with Wei's mechanic to get his [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder's]] backup memory to determine the places Wei's been to previously.<ref name="conviction" />
